stories.title: Two paths, one flux: Trapped ions simulate Aharonov–Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory
stories.desc: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers demonstrated the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a quantum simulation of a lattice gauge theory using a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer.

stories.title: A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
stories.desc: Scientists have discovered a surprising quantum limit that prevents electrons from being tracked with unlimited precision in both space and time. The breakthrough could pave the way for manipulating chemical reactions and developing electronics hundreds of thousands of times faster than today's…
